subject: general
question: Deendayal Port, is a ______ port located in Kandla, Gujarat.
solution:
The correct answer is __**tidal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deendayal Port**, also known as** Kandla Port**, is one of the major ports in India, situated in the state of** Gujarat.**
 
• It was established in **1950 **and has been functioning for over 70 years.
 
• It is a permanent port and has been operating for several decades.
 
• It is **a tidal port,** meaning the water level in the port area fluctuates with the tides.
 
• It is one of the largest ports in India, handling a significant amount of cargo.
